data.name: Eve
data.message: Weapons done, heading to electrical. Want to come?

I found Charlie's body in electrical. I came from weapons through cafeteria to get here. Frank was with me in weapons from tick 16-18 — he came in from security. So Frank has an alibi with me for that stretch.

Also worth noting: Diana is also dead somewhere — I didn't see her body, so someone else's path might tell us where. Since Frank and I were together in weapons, and I went weapons -> cafeteria -> electrical, that leaves Alice and Bob unaccounted for. One of them is likely our Duck. Let's hear where they were.

I've been on the engine side the whole round. Started in lower engine working on my task, then moved up to upper engine. I haven't seen anyone this entire round — no encounters, no bodies, nothing. Just me and the engines.

So I can't vouch for anyone, but I also wasn't anywhere near electrical where Charlie was found. Electrical is across the map from upper/lower engine — would've taken me several ticks to get there and back, and I was doing tasks the whole time.

Eve, your story about Frank checks out on your end, but we only have your word that you went weapons -> cafeteria -> electrical. Reporting the body doesn't automatically clear you either. I'd like to hear Frank confirm the weapons timing, and Bob needs to account for himself. If Bob was nowhere near electrical, then we have a real problem with either Eve's story or someone's missing alibi.

Bob, where were you?

Eve is absolutely right, I can fully confirm her timeline. We were together in Weapons around tick 16-18. My route this round was Upper Engine -> Oxygen -> Cafeteria -> Weapons. I never went south towards Electrical or Security, so I didn't see Charlie or Diana at all.

Alice, I started near Upper Engine but moved east toward Oxygen pretty early, so it makes sense we missed each other if you were down in Lower Engine first. However, that does mean you've been completely unobserved this whole time. 

But the biggest question mark here is Bob. Alice hasn't seen him, Eve hasn't seen him, and I haven't seen him. With two dead bodies somewhere on the map (Charlie in Electrical and Diana missing), the killer had a very busy round. Bob is completely unaccounted for, which makes him the most likely candidate to be roaming and picking people off. 

I'm extremely suspicious of Bob right now. Let's hear what he has to say, but unless he has an ironclad alibi, he's my top suspect. I know Eve is safe based on our time in Weapons, so it really has to be between Bob and Alice.

I'll be straight with you all: I've been on the south side of the map this whole round. My route was navigation -> storage -> medbay. I was doing my tasks and didn't run into anyone — no encounters, no bodies along the way.

Now I know that sounds bad because I have no one to vouch for me, but let me point something out: Alice is in the exact same position. She claims engine side, I claim south side, neither of us saw anyone. The difference is — let's look at the geography.

Charlie was killed in electrical. Diana is dead somewhere we don't know. Electrical connects to cafeteria, security, and storage. I went THROUGH storage on my way to medbay. If I had killed Charlie in electrical, I'd have had to detour there and back, and the timing gets tight.

But here's what bothers me about Frank and Eve's story: they're vouching for each other very hard. Yes, they were together in weapons tick 16-18, but that's a narrow window. Eve then goes weapons -> cafeteria -> electrical and "conveniently" finds the body. Cafeteria connects directly to electrical. Eve had perfect opportunity to kill Charlie in electrical and then "report" it.

Frank's alibi only covers Eve for ticks 16-18. Before and after that, Eve was alone.

I'm most suspicious of Eve — the reporter with the cleanest-sounding story and direct access to the body. Alice and I are both unobserved but neither of us was near electrical. I'm voting Eve.

Bob, you've got the speaker order confused — I already spoke first. But I'll address your accusation directly since you're pointing at me.

Yes, I went weapons -> cafeteria -> electrical and found Charlie. That's exactly what I said. But think about the timing: I was in weapons with Frank through tick 18, then it takes 2 ticks to cafeteria, 2 more to electrical. That puts me arriving at electrical around tick 22 — which is when I reported. There's no window where I'm "alone with Charlie" long enough to kill and stage anything. The body was already there when I walked in.

Also, you say you went navigation -> storage -> medbay. Storage connects directly to electrical. You had just as much access to electrical as I did via cafeteria — arguably more, since storage-electrical is a direct connection. And Diana's body is still unaccounted for. If she was killed in storage or medbay, that's right on your path.

Frank vouches for me in weapons, and my arrival time at electrical matches reporting the body immediately. You have no witnesses and your route passes through rooms adjacent to electrical.

I'm leaning Bob, but I want to hear if anyone can corroborate any piece of his route before we lock it in.

I already gave my route — lower engine to upper engine, no encounters, nowhere near electrical. I stand by that.

Now looking at what's been said: Eve and Frank vouch for each other in weapons 16-18. Eve's timing to electrical (weapons -> cafeteria -> electrical = 4 ticks) lines up with a tick 22 report. That's tight and consistent.

Bob, your counter is interesting but has a problem. You claim navigation -> storage -> medbay. Storage connects directly to electrical AND to medbay. That puts you adjacent to electrical on your route. You also went through storage, where Diana could easily have been killed. Two bodies, and your path threads right between both potential murder scenes.

Eve at least has Frank confirming part of her route. You have nothing, and your geography is actually worse than mine — I was on the far west engine side the entire round, nowhere near either crime scene. You were one room away from electrical.

I'm leaning Bob. Frank, since you confirmed Eve's timing, do you have any reason to doubt her between when you split up and when she reported? If not, Bob is the most likely Duck here.

Alice, you hit the nail on the head. Eve's timeline from when we separated in Weapons is exactly right — it leaves her absolutely zero time to kill Charlie and stage a report. It takes 4 ticks to get from Weapons to Electrical, which completely fills the gap between tick 18 and tick 22. I completely trust Eve on this.

Bob, your defense just doesn't hold up. As Alice pointed out, you passed right through Storage, which connects directly to Electrical. You had the perfect opportunity and the positioning to take out Charlie, and probably Diana too along that south corridor. Trying to turn this around on Eve when her alibi is mathematically proven by my timing just feels like a desperate play from a cornered Duck.

Eve, Alice — we are all completely on the same page here. Bob's route is too convenient for the murders and he has no one to clear him. I'm locking in my vote for Bob. Let's get him out.

Look, I can see where this is heading and I'm clearly the convenient target here. But let me make my case one more time before you lock this in.

Eve's "mathematical alibi" relies entirely on Frank's word. Frank and Eve are vouching for each other — that's a classic duck pair tactic. If Frank is the Duck, he's covering for Eve. If Eve is the Duck, Frank's confirmation is doing all the heavy lifting. Neither of them is independently verified by anyone else.

Yes, storage connects to electrical. But it also connects to medbay, which is where I ended up. My route is a straight south-side line: navigation -> storage -> medbay. Going to electrical from storage would have added travel time that doesn't fit my arrival in medbay. Meanwhile, Eve admits she went directly past cafeteria to electrical and "happened" to find the body the moment she arrived.

Alice's route on the engine side is the cleanest geographically — I'll grant her that. But between Eve and me, Eve had direct access to the crime scene and Frank's "alibi" only covers a 2-tick window.

I'm a Goose. I know you're all going to vote me anyway, but if I'm wrong about Eve, then Frank is the Duck protecting her. Either way, watch them carefully next round.

I'm voting Eve.
